title: Maintenance request
passage:
Where should I submit the maintenance request?
A. It took about an hour.
B. The new machine is quieter.
C. Submit it through the internal equipment portal.
passageZh:

B. 新機器比較安靜。
C. 請透過內部設備入口網站提交。
